name: The Real American Zeroes

tenures.source: Won the fed's first-ever World Tag Teem title by tournament on the fed's own 3 June 1999 broadcast, and lost it eleven days later on the fed's own 14 June 1999 broadcast.
tenures.note: Billed part of a larger military-parody trio, the Corporate Express Club, alongside a non-competing on-screen manager; only the two in-ring members are recorded as the tag team of record.

caption: A military-parody tag team of G.I. Slow and Sergeant Slumber, the first wrestlers ever billed LOL World Tag Teem Champions after winning the previously vacant title by tournament in June 1999.
